decisions.decision: Source-B raw_data is sourced from a new verbatim ChargingSessionTesla.Raw field (captured in the DTO's UnmarshalJSON, L2), not by re-marshalling the typed struct. Honors the confirmed 'lossless whole session' design (D9) with true parity to vehicle_snapshots.raw_data, without changing the tesla ChargingHistory port signature.
decisions.why: Tier-1 ChargingHistory returns only the typed DTO (no raw), so B5 had nothing verbatim to store; re-marshalling would lose unmodeled fields + emit Go-cased timestamp keys. Capturing raw in UnmarshalJSON (which already receives the bytes) is a one-line, boundary-clean leader tesla edit. Fulfills a confirmed design point, so no user re-gate.
